title: Storage, automatic cleanup on with recorded result
expect: Auto Cleanup is on with a neutral Experimental label and the same action phrase as when off. Last freed 2.3 GB · Oct 20 is appended to the section footnote from seeded completion facts, not a live cleanup or cloud inference.

All temporary-file categories measure 0 B, so their rows, section heading and notes are hidden. The free-after-saving switch remains the first row of the automatic group; its footnote is followed by the standard gap before Free up space now.
The legend omits BackupDuck's measured-zero category, leaving Photos and other space on one line when they fit.
